summary: 11:30 PM ET run, published at 12:06 AM ET. Nothing to settle: the only recent final is Monday's Giants at Rams, settled at 12:06 AM yesterday, and no game kicked today. Nothing open to close. No weekly review due, with NFL week 2 reviewed on Tuesday morning and college week 3 on Monday. The one thing that changed tonight is worth recording: the capture window opened. The college pull took 70 games at 12:54 AM and the NFL pull ran on the hosted workflow at 12:54 AM as well, so the board has 296 open game rows carrying more than one book where this morning it had none. The three totals we have been holding all week now have real shopped prices, and two of them still clear the model lean bar. The decision on them belongs to the 6:45 run, whose job that is; this run settles.
takeaways: Iowa at Michigan over 38.5 is the strongest of the three and is better on a shopped price than it was on the relayed one. BetMGM has 38.5 at -110 and DraftKings 38.5 at -112, against FanDuel at 39.5 and BetRivers at 39. Our number is 47.1 and the calibrated chance is 57.3% against the 52.4% a -110 price needs, so the edge is 4.9 points rather than the 4.4 the single relayed quote showed. Shopping bought half a point of edge, which is the whole argument for waiting made concrete.

Ravens at Cowboys under is still there but thinner than it looked. The best number is BetRivers 53 at -113, which is half a point better than the 52.5 everywhere else but at a worse price, and the edge comes out at 2.1 points rather than the 3.3 the relayed DraftKings quote suggested. It clears the one point bar and it is the weaker of the two.

Seahawks at Commanders stays passed on last night's reasoning rather than on price. Both starting quarterbacks are on the week 3 report, Jayden Daniels doubtful and Sam Darnold questionable, and our total comes from a model that does not carry a quarterback change. The shopped price would have been BetRivers 40 at -110 for a 2.3 point edge. We are not taking it, and the reason is the model's blind spot rather than the number.

Waiting cost nothing and gained something on all three. This is the counterpart to Monday, when three prop leans went out on DraftKings alone before the other books posted and all three finished holding the worst number on the board. Same rule, opposite outcome, five days apart.
